subtopic: Geometry of Complex Numbers (Argand Geometry & Loci)
title: Worked: reading a locus off the words

board_content.text: Equidistant from $2$ and $-2$ — the perpendicular bisector of that segment.
Match to the standard form $|z-z_0|=r$: read off $z_0$ and $r$ directly.
Translate the words; you rarely need to expand.

segments_english.text: Let's practise reading a locus straight from the words, with two quick examples.
First, find the locus of z satisfying modulus of z minus two equals modulus of z plus two.
In words, z is equidistant from the points two and minus two. That is exactly the perpendicular bisector of the segment joining them.
That segment lies on the real axis, so its perpendicular bisector is the imaginary axis: the real part of z is zero.
Second, identify the curve modulus of z minus three equals two.
This is the set of points at distance two from the point three, so it's a circle with centre at three comma zero and radius two.
You get that just by matching to the standard form, modulus of z minus z zero equals r, and reading off z zero and r directly. No algebra needed.
That's the pattern throughout: translate the geometric words, and you rarely need to expand anything into a plus i b.

segments_hinglish.text: Locus ko seedha words se padhna practise karte hain, do quick examples ke saath.
Pehle, z ka locus nikaalo jo modulus of z minus two barabar modulus of z plus two satisfy karta ho.
Words mein, z points two aur minus two se equidistant hai. Ye bilkul unhe jodne wale segment ka perpendicular bisector hai.
Wo segment real axis par hai, to iska perpendicular bisector imaginary axis hai: z ka real part zero.
Doosra, curve modulus of z minus three barabar two ko identify karo.
Ye point three se distance two par ke points ka set hai, to ye ek circle hai centre three comma zero aur radius two ke saath.
Ye aapko bas standard form, modulus of z minus z zero barabar r, se match karke, z zero aur r seedha padhke milta hai. Koi algebra nahi chahiye.
Ye pattern har jagah hai: geometric words translate karo, aur aapko shaayad hi kabhi kuch a plus i b mein expand karna pade.
